To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
static analysis can be used for XML access control, and that this approach can be used for optimizing XML queries.

1) Static analysis can be used to determine whether access-control policies are satisfied by XML queries; 2) Static analysis can determine whether a query is guaranteed to access only permitted elements and attributes in XML documents; 3) Static analysis can optimize access-denied query expressions to empty lists; 4) Static analysis can support value-based access-control; 5) Static analysis can use view schemas for XML documents.
static analysis can be used to optimize access control for XML.
